rules.description: Scope 1 greenhouse gas emissions must be inventoried
rules.remediation: Build a Scope 1 GHG inventory (diesel, explosives, on-site generation) following the GHG Protocol.

rules.description: Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions must be inventoried
rules.remediation: Quantify purchased-electricity emissions using market- or location-based factors.

rules.description: Dust (PM10) at site boundary must not exceed 50 µg/m³ (24h avg)
rules.remediation: Apply dust suppression (water carts, surface stabilisation) on haul roads and re-monitor boundary PM10.

rules.description: An emissions reduction target must be formally adopted
rules.remediation: Adopt a board-approved emissions reduction target with baseline year and interim milestones.

rules.description: NOx emissions from mobile fleet must be within permitted limits
rules.remediation: Service or retrofit fleet engines (SCR/EGR) and verify stack/emitter compliance testing.

rules.description: Refrigerant/ozone-depleting substances register must be maintained
rules.remediation: Maintain an inventory of ozone-depleting substances with leak-check records and phase-out plan.
